description: Bike and Pedestrian Trip Counts is a dataset listed in City of Norfolk open data portal (data.norfolk.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Norfolk. Bike and pedestrian counters have been installed at six locations along the Elizabeth River Trail and at 15 locations along Norfolk’s existing bike lanes to accurately track pedestrian and cyclist use along the trail and bike network. Coverage: Norfolk, Virginia. The portal files it under the category Recreation. Its tags are transportation, city services & operations, count, cyclist, date. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Anna Dewey, Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-norfolk-gov-portal.
